FOR AGENTS

AI drafts on tickets: when a mailbox's email AI agent is on, a ticket from an email shows an AI draft: what the email is about, how sure the agent is, the customer's mood and language, and a reply written from your knowledge base with the articles it used. Approve and send it, edit it first, or discard it. A draft is only ever sent once, however many people press Send.

New tickets get a team: a ticket you make by hand (New ticket, or Open a ticket during a call or chat) now starts with your team and its usual queue filled in. If you are in more than one team, you choose which.

FOR ADMINISTRATORS

Email AI agent: switch it on per mailbox (Messaging → the mailbox → Email AI agent) and choose the AI connection. It recognises the type of each email (order or delivery, billing, password or log-in, fault, cancellation, complaint, sales enquiry, other; you can rename and add your own), fills in the ticket's category and priority, and drafts a reply from the knowledge base. Every type starts as draft only; for the types you choose, it may answer by itself when it is sure enough, within an hourly limit. Complaints and sensitive emails are never sent by themselves, and it never makes up an answer the knowledge base does not have. The mailbox page shows what it read, drafted, sent and handed over.

Default queue for new tickets: set it under Ticket settings, for tickets made by hand when the person's team has no usual queue.

Roadmap: Help → Roadmap shows what is planned, in development, being tested and released, with links to each release's notes.

FOR PLATFORM OPERATORS

Roadmap: keep it under Platform → Roadmap: add items, move them through the stages, and choose which are shown to resellers and tenants (new items start internal)."}
